newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Oct 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Oct 17.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
President Jiang Zemin and Defense Minister Chi Haotian observe the 60th anniversary of end of the Communist Party's Long March.
Officials at a national AIDS conference urge China to go to war against AIDS to fight the rapid spread of the deadly disease.
Vice-premier Zhu Rongji urges China to ensure that the state buys all grain that farmers want to sell this year and that funds for the purchases are not misused.
The People's Bank of China, the central bank, issues regulations on the management of financing companies.
Income from industrial and commercial taxes in September increased by nearly 7.9 billion yuan compared with the same period a year ago.
